restaurant.name: Al Viro
restaurant.tagline: A symphony of authentic Italian flavors crafted with passion and precision
restaurant.reservation_policy: Reservations are held for up to 15 minutes. Large groups (6+) require a 24-hour advance booking.

dishes.name: Truffle Risotto
dishes.description: Creamy Carnaroli rice cooked with aromatic black winter truffles, aged Parmigiano Reggiano, and white wine glaze.

dishes.name: Margherita Classica
dishes.description: Wood-fired traditional pizza with San Marzano tomato sauce, fresh buffalo mozzarella, fragrant basil, and extra virgin olive oil.

dishes.name: Lobster Ravioli
dishes.description: Handmade squid-ink ravioli stuffed with Atlantic lobster and mascarpone, served in a delicate saffron shellfish bisque.

dishes.name: Osso Buco alla Milanese
dishes.description: Tender braised veal shank simmered with white wine, root vegetables, and gremolata, served over golden saffron risotto.

dishes.name: Penne all'Arrabbiata
dishes.description: Al dente penne pasta tossed in a fiery San Marzano tomato sauce infused with garlic, fresh red Calabrian chilies, and parsley.

dishes.name: Bruschetta al Pomodoro
dishes.description: Crispy toasted artisanal sourdough topped with marinated Heirloom tomatoes, roasted garlic, fresh basil, and balsamic reduction glaze.

dishes.name: Classic Tiramisu
dishes.description: Traditional Venetian dessert layered with espresso-dipped Savoiardi ladyfingers, velvety mascarpone cream, and Dutch cocoa powder.

dishes.name: Fettuccine Alfredo con Pollo
dishes.description: Fresh fettuccine tossed in a rich emulsion of cultured butter, heavy cream, 24-month Parmigiano Reggiano, and grilled rosemary chicken.

dishes.name: Diavola Pizza
dishes.description: Wood-fired sourdough pizza topped with spicy Calabrian salami, Fior di Latte mozzarella, chili honey drizzle, and fresh oregano.

dishes.name: Burrata Pugliese Salad
dishes.description: Fresh whole artisanal burrata cheese surrounded by roasted sweet cherry tomatoes, wild arugula, pine nut pesto, and aged balsamic glaze.

dishes.name: Butter Chicken
dishes.description: Rich and creamy tomato-based curry with tender tandoori chicken pieces.

dishes.name: Paneer Tikka Masala
dishes.description: Marinated cottage cheese cubes grilled and simmered in a spiced tomato-onion gravy.

dishes.name: Dal Makhani
dishes.description: Slow-cooked black lentils and kidney beans enriched with cream and butter.

dishes.name: Chicken Biryani
dishes.description: Aromatic basmati rice cooked with marinated chicken, saffron, and whole spices.

dishes.name: Mutton Rogan Josh
dishes.description: Classic Kashmiri curry featuring tender lamb slow-cooked with aromatic spices.

dishes.name: Palak Paneer

dishes.name: Malai Kofta
dishes.description: Fried potato and paneer dumplings in a rich, sweet, and creamy cashew gravy.
